topics.name: Runtime Activation Monitor
topics.purpose: Define a read-only Expose monitor showing repository accepted snapshot versus runtime active snapshot, activation/reload state, boot profile and rollback targets.

semantics.separation_rule: Accepted, candidate and runtime-active snapshot states are visibly distinct.
semantics.action_rule: Activate/reload/rollback operations invoke separate authorized lifecycle operations.
semantics.authority_rule: Viewing runtime state grants no lifecycle authority.
semantics.trace_rule: Every lifecycle result links exact runtime/snapshot/profile refs.
semantics.failure_rule: Partial/failed activation is displayed explicitly rather than represented as active.
semantics.ac_rule: AccessCore state is shown as governed runtime state, not as repository acceptance.

invariants.rule: Repository acceptance establishes canonical source state; runtime activation/reload is a separate explicit lifecycle operation over an exact accepted snapshot.

hard_gates.condition: monitor conflates accepted and active snapshot
monitor directly activates without explicit operation
